Safe and fast ATE replacement part identification new as an app!
ATE is your partner for high quality components like expendable brake parts and hydraulic parts as well as special tools and testing devices. In addition, we always surprise our partners with an extra service, which makes your daily work easier and keeps you moving forward.
With the ATE app, you can search for ATE original spare parts by entering the numbers as well as using the vehicle selection. Different search criteria are available: vehicle selection, KBA number, Type Mine, ATE article number, ATE short item number, OE number, comparable number.
The app is based on the extensive ATE catalog database with the original data of the manufacturer including article information and product images.
Perfect for use in the workshop, trade and industry, but also for private use.
The icon "Locations" helps you to conveniently find your nearest ATE partner via route planner. By request, including detailed information about the selected company.
ATE brake parts can also be identified by barcode scanner. Instead of entering the numbers, the corresponding vehicle usages can be easily and conveniently viewed in the "Article Search" menu.

It provides information in a few seconds about whether the article is really original or if it is possibly a forgery. In addition, a review of the PrioSpot takes place. After you have scanned the QR code, a picture of the Holospot with the four-digit code appears, to compare with the packaging.
